Main_independent_findings: Actual Mod constructor registers item/effect/serializable attachment and ServerEventHandler; actual NEW factory maps to ECLIPSED. Marker is neutral with no own tick. Four other Paw types and generic registration are support0.

Complete Paw use requests sound first, shared item cooldown for non-infinite actor and durability, then client decorations. Common target loop has no own side guard. It selects all Living within radius10 except actor, without an explicit hostile/team/Boss/LOS filter.

Target addEffect result is ignored and target decoration requests are unconditional. consume and sound do not acknowledge authoritative effect acceptance; no duplicated client/server effect or actual payment success is asserted.
Applicable refuses every incoming effect while ECLIPSED is present and not endsWithin1; this includes beneficial effects and ECLIPSED itself. Broad veto is already owned elsewhere and alone earns0.

Added for ECLIPSED stores each other active instance under effect Holder then requests removeAllEffects. It retains references, not copies or a pre-removal transaction receipt. The full containing event method has independent poison/sunblock/frozen branches; Eclipsed branch has no own server guard.

Whole LivingData restore iterates stored values through addEffect, ignores results and clears map unconditionally. Both Remove and Expired request this restore. No per-entry acknowledgement/retry, clone of original state, elapsed-duration correction or proven frozen hidden chain is present.

Attachment persists retained instances as a compound list and decodes nonnull entries by type. It does not clear map before decode; absent list retains existing map. This save/load support is not a new migration owner.
